scope: Isolated desktop-engine acceptance of one-screen iPad layouts. No physical iPad was operated.

productionBundle.audioScope: Sound and music disabled in synthetic profiles; these runs do not audit audio quality or audio release completeness.

engines.browserVersionEvidence: Separate launch of the same installed binary/channel while verification ran; not instrumentation of the test browser instance.

checks: Document vertical/horizontal dimensions fit within a 2px rounding tolerance.
Named functional panels and every visible overflow:auto/scroll container have no vertical overflow; hiding excess content does not pass.
Operation bounding boxes and rendered meaningful text stay inside the viewport and clipping ancestors.
Enabled operation centers are not covered by another element.
Deliberately clipped, offscreen and covered actions are rejected by the checker self-verification.

coverage.home: Due reviews, 20 profiles with full 16-Han-character nicknames across every dropdown page, final profile selection and switched home.
coverage.catalogs: Hanzi first/next/search results; poem first/next and difficulty filter.
coverage.parents: All five navigation pages, all five pages of 20 maximum-length profile nicknames, restore confirmation with all 20 complete nicknames across all ten preview pages; parental gate, install guide and rest reminder dialogs.
coverage.wordPlay: Twenty unique semantic implementations plus generic vocabulary/meaning steps, initial and completed states; sunrise/night share an implementation and Snow is an inline fixture.
coverage.hanzi: Stages 0–6 including quiz feedback, completed writing, orientation changes, sentence/parent confirmation and completion navigation.
coverage.poems: Stages 0–6, all recitation phases; short poem, most-line poem, longest single line and longest interpretation; all exposed reading/story/hint pages and discovery state.
coverage.zoo: All food pages, feed/bath/placement/rename, all 27 pages of 160 invitations, all 14 grassland pages of a 161-item mature zoo, building detail/placement and earned-reward state.

inputMechanisms: Native Playwright clicks/keyboard slider End and pointer mouse drags/hold in both engines for layout transitions.
This layout suite does not use continuous native touch; the separate 19-case touch audit covers Chromium CDP Touch → Pointer and multi-finger cancellation.

snowFixture.implementation: Temporary browser route with esbuild-bundled repository WordPlay and inline source styles/classroom shell. No production route/resource is written.

linuxCI.server: Build first, then run node scripts/serve-lan.mjs --port 5173.
linuxCI.commandTemplate: IPAD_LAYOUT_TEST_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 IPAD_LAYOUT_ENGINE=<chromium|webkit> PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL=chromium npx playwright test tests/ipad-layout.spec.ts --workers=1 --reporter=line
linuxCI.safeAreaCommand: IPAD_LAYOUT_TEST_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 IPAD_LAYOUT_ENGINE=chromium IPAD_LAYOUT_SAFE_INSETS=20 PLAYWRIGHT_CHANNEL=chromium npx playwright test tests/ipad-layout.spec.ts --workers=1 --reporter=line --grep 'Safari usable landscape'

limitations: Desktop Chromium/WebKit simulation with iPad viewport, mobile, touch and iPad user-agent settings; no physical iPad Air 5 or iPadOS Safari acceptance.

The four viewport sizes represent full-screen and reduced Safari usable space. Chromium adds a 20px top/bottom CDP safe-area simulation whose actual CSS env values are checked; no real device safe-area geometry or Safari chrome was measured.
Synthetic profiles/checkpoints test layout and operations; they do not establish learning or mastery.
Representative games, stress course content and all lesson stages are covered; these browser runs do not exhaust every character, stroke dataset or all 300 poems.
Native Home Screen installation, real keyboard occlusion, Apple Pencil input and audio quality are outside this audit.

sourceSnapshots.scope: All repository src files plus index.html; code, CSS and bundled curriculum data.
sourceSnapshots.canonicalDigestInput: Sorted file path + NUL + file SHA-256 + newline (UTF-8).

safeAreaSupplement.cssEnvAssertions: Every measured state asserts computed CSS env(safe-area-inset-top/bottom) equals 20px, not merely that the override request succeeded.

run.command: IPAD_LAYOUT_TEST_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 IPAD_LAYOUT_ENGINE=chromium IPAD_LAYOUT_SAFE_INSETS=20 IPAD_LAYOUT_DIAGNOSTICS=1 npx playwright test tests/ipad-layout.spec.ts --workers=1 --reporter=json --grep 'Safari usable landscape' --output=test-results/ipad-one-screen-production-safe-insets > /tmp/kidchinese-ipad-one-screen-production-safe-insets.json 2> /tmp/kidchinese-ipad-one-screen-production-safe-insets.stderr.log
